references.text: The territory of the tribe of Reuben and their attachment to livestock, explaining why they stayed with their flocks instead of fighting
The tribe of Reuben built pens for their small cattle, showing their prioritization of livestock over warfare
Jacob's prophecy about Reuben, describing the tribe's instability and lack of leadership
The preceding verse that also mentions Reuben's division and hesitation in facing the war against Sisera
Moses' blessing over Reuben, suggesting the tribe's vulnerable position and need for protection
